provenance.source: Claude Code subagent (a new general-purpose agent, separate from both development rounds; model inherited: claude-opus-5-5)
provenance.instructions: Read exactly one file (heldout-prompts.json) and no other; no database access; reply to each prompt independently. The subagent reported 1 tool use.
provenance.extraction: responses[qid] = json.dumps(raw[qid]) — a mechanical split of the single raw reply; no text was edited.

responses.H1: {"interpretation": "Counts source rows (not distinct case numbers) where CASE_STATUS = 'Certified' exactly (Certified - Withdrawn excluded), VISA_CLASS = 'H-1B' exactly (H-1B1 and E-3 excluded), and title_has(JOB_TITLE, 'business analyst') = 1. That is a whole-phrase title match: 'Senior Business Analyst' and 'Business-Analyst' match; 'Business Analysts', 'Business Systems Analyst' and other unnamed classes do not. Worksite means the row's single recorded WORKSITE_STATE, normalized with UPPER(TRIM(...)) and matched to 'TX' (or the spelled-out 'TEXAS' if present). Additional worksites are not in this table.", "sql": "SELECT COUNT(*) AS cases FROM lca WHERE CASE_STATUS = 'Certified' AND VISA_CLASS = 'H-1B' AND title_has(JOB_TITLE, 'business analyst') = 1 AND UPPER(TRIM(WORKSITE_STATE)) IN ('TX', 'TEXAS')", "rows_sql": "SELECT sheet_row, CASE_NUMBER, CASE_STATUS, VISA_CLASS, EMPLOYER_NAME, JOB_TITLE, WORKSITE_CITY, WORKSITE_STATE FROM lca WHERE CASE_STATUS = 'Certified' AND VISA_CLASS = 'H-1B' AND title_has(JOB_TITLE, 'business analyst') = 1 AND UPPER(TRIM(WORKSITE_STATE)) IN ('TX', 'TEXAS') ORDER BY sheet_row", "answer_type": "count", "limits": "No LIMIT; all matching rows are counted and listed. Only the one recorded worksite per row is checked; cases with Texas only as an additional worksite are not in this table. An LCA certification is not a visa approval, job offer, or hire.", "needs_clarification": false}
responses.H2: {"interpretation": "Ranks employers by count of source rows where CASE_STATUS = 'Certified' exactly, VISA_CLASS = 'H-1B' exactly, with no job-title filter, and the row's single recorded worksite is Boston, MA (UPPER(TRIM(WORKSITE_CITY)) = 'BOSTON' and UPPER(TRIM(WORKSITE_STATE)) IN ('MA', 'MASSACHUSETTS')). Employers are grouped and labelled by TRIM(EMPLOYER_NAME) without merging different spellings; a NULL or empty name is labelled '[blank]'. Ordered by cases descending, then employer name ascending, top 10 as requested.", "sql": "SELECT CASE WHEN EMPLOYER_NAME IS NULL OR TRIM(EMPLOYER_NAME) = '' THEN '[blank]' ELSE TRIM(EMPLOYER_NAME) END AS employer_name, COUNT(*) AS cases FROM lca WHERE CASE_STATUS = 'Certified' AND VISA_CLASS = 'H-1B' AND UPPER(TRIM(WORKSITE_CITY)) = 'BOSTON' AND UPPER(TRIM(WORKSITE_STATE)) IN ('MA', 'MASSACHUSETTS') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 ASC LIMIT 10", "rows_sql": "SELECT sheet_row, CASE_NUMBER, CASE_STATUS, VISA_CLASS, EMPLOYER_NAME, JOB_TITLE, WORKSITE_CITY, WORKSITE_STATE FROM lca WHERE CASE_STATUS = 'Certified' AND VISA_CLASS = 'H-1B' AND UPPER(TRIM(WORKSITE_CITY)) = 'BOSTON' AND UPPER(TRIM(WORKSITE_STATE)) IN ('MA', 'MASSACHUSETTS') AND (CASE WHEN EMPLOYER_NAME IS NULL OR TRIM(EMPLOYER_NAME) = '' THEN '[blank]' ELSE TRIM(EMPLOYER_NAME) END) IN (SELECT CASE WHEN EMPLOYER_NAME IS NULL OR TRIM(EMPLOYER_NAME) = '' THEN '[blank]' ELSE TRIM(EMPLOYER_NAME) END FROM lca WHERE CASE_STATUS = 'Certified' AND VISA_CLASS = 'H-1B' AND UPPER(TRIM(WORKSITE_CITY)) = 'BOSTON' AND UPPER(TRIM(WORKSITE_STATE)) IN ('MA', 'MASSACHUSETTS') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, 1 ASC LIMIT 10) ORDER BY TRIM(EMPLOYER_NAME), sheet_row", "answer_type": "ranking", "limits": "Top 10 only, as the question asks; ties at rank 10 are broken alphabetically by employer name. City matching is exact after trimming and upper-casing, so variant city spellings are not merged. Only the one recorded worksite per row is checked; additional worksites are not in this table. Counts are filed LCAs, not visa approvals or hires.", "needs_clarification": false}
responses.H3: {"interpretation": "Median of the offered annual base wage, CAST(WAGE_RATE_OF_PAY_FROM AS REAL), the lower bound of the filed wage range and not total compensation. Uses only rows where WAGE_UNIT_OF_PAY = 'Year'; other units are excluded, not converted. Filters are CASE_STATUS = 'Certified' exactly, VISA_CLASS = 'H-1B' exactly, title_has(JOB_TITLE, 'data scientist') = 1 (whole-phrase match; 'Senior Data Scientist' matches, 'Data Scientists' and unnamed classes do not), and the row's single recorded WORKSITE_STATE is California (UPPER(TRIM(...)) IN ('CA', 'CALIFORNIA')). Uses the provided median() aggregate.", "sql": "SELECT median(CAST(WAGE_RATE_OF_PAY_FROM AS REAL)) AS median_annual_wage_usd FROM lca WHERE CASE_STATUS = 'Certified' AND VISA_CLASS = 'H-1B' AND title_has(JOB_TITLE, 'data scientist') = 1 AND UPPER(TRIM(WORKSITE_STATE)) IN ('CA', 'CALIFORNIA') AND WAGE_UNIT_OF_PAY = 'Year'", "rows_sql": "SELECT sheet_row, CASE_NUMBER, CASE_STATUS, VISA_CLASS, EMPLOYER_NAME, JOB_TITLE, WORKSITE_CITY, WORKSITE_STATE FROM lca WHERE CASE_STATUS = 'Certified' AND VISA_CLASS = 'H-1B' AND title_has(JOB_TITLE, 'data scientist') = 1 AND UPPER(TRIM(WORKSITE_STATE)) IN ('CA', 'CALIFORNIA') AND WAGE_UNIT_OF_PAY = 'Year' ORDER BY sheet_row", "answer_type": "count", "limits": "No LIMIT and no minimum sample size. Non-annual wage units are excluded, so the median covers yearly-unit rows only. It is the median of the filed lower-bound base wage, not total compensation or actual pay. Only the one recorded worksite per row is checked.", "needs_clarification": false}
responses.H4: {"interpretation": "Counts source rows by prevailing-wage level where CASE_STATUS = 'Certified' exactly, VISA_CLASS = 'H-1B' exactly, and SOC code 15-2051 (Data Scientists). The SOC match is SUBSTR(TRIM(SOC_CODE), 1, 7) = '15-2051', so any O*NET suffix such as '.00' is included; no job-title filter is applied. Levels are grouped by TRIM(PW_WAGE_LEVEL); NULL or empty values are labelled '[blank]' and kept as their own row.", "sql": "SELECT CASE WHEN PW_WAGE_LEVEL IS NULL OR TRIM(PW_WAGE_LEVEL) = '' THEN '[blank]' ELSE TRIM(PW_WAGE_LEVEL) END AS wage_level, COUNT(*) AS cases FROM lca WHERE CASE_STATUS = 'Certified' AND VISA_CLASS = 'H-1B' AND SUBSTR(TRIM(SOC_CODE), 1, 7) = '15-2051' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 ASC", "rows_sql": "SELECT sheet_row, CASE_NUMBER, CASE_STATUS, VISA_CLASS, EMPLOYER_NAME, JOB_TITLE, WORKSITE_CITY, WORKSITE_STATE FROM lca WHERE CASE_STATUS = 'Certified' AND VISA_CLASS = 'H-1B' AND SUBSTR(TRIM(SOC_CODE), 1, 7) = '15-2051' ORDER BY sheet_row", "answer_type": "table", "limits": "No LIMIT; every wage level is shown, including '[blank]'. Classification is by SOC code only, not job title. The SOC prefix match includes any O*NET sub-codes under 15-2051 if they appear in the data.", "needs_clarification": false}
responses.H5: {"interpretation": "Counts source rows (not distinct case numbers) where CASE_STATUS = 'Denied' exactly, VISA_CLASS = 'H-1B' exactly, and title_has(JOB_TITLE, 'data engineer') = 1. That is a whole-phrase title match: 'Senior Data Engineer' and 'Data-Engineer' match; 'Data Engineers', 'Big Data Engineering' and unnamed classes do not. No worksite filter.", "sql": "SELECT COUNT(*) AS cases FROM lca WHERE CASE_STATUS = 'Denied' AND VISA_CLASS = 'H-1B' AND title_has(JOB_TITLE, 'data engineer') = 1", "rows_sql": "SELECT sheet_row, CASE_NUMBER, CASE_STATUS, VISA_CLASS, EMPLOYER_NAME, JOB_TITLE, WORKSITE_CITY, WORKSITE_STATE FROM lca WHERE CASE_STATUS = 'Denied' AND VISA_CLASS = 'H-1B' AND title_has(JOB_TITLE, 'data engineer') = 1 ORDER BY sheet_row", "answer_type": "count", "limits": "No LIMIT; all matching rows are counted and listed. 'Denied' is the DOL decision on the Labor Condition Application, not a USCIS visa denial. Withdrawn and Certified - Withdrawn cases are not counted as denied.", "needs_clarification": false}
